widgets_values: An adult Chinese noblewoman in an ornate phoenix-patterned robe and gold crown stands inside the entrance of a colossal imperial palace hall. The hall's giant golden columns, coffered ceiling, and layered roof beams dominate about 80% of the visible frame, extending beyond the upper and side edges. A low ground-level camera looks steeply upward from golden floor tiles and stone steps; tiny distant palace attendants and glowing palace lanterns establish scale. The woman remains the visual focus in the middle distance, her complete silhouette recognizable and her body proportions natural. Ultra-wide 16mm perspective, deep layered space: foreground step edge, midground figure, monumental background columns. Warm gold, vermilion, ink black, and jade green palette; dramatic side-back lighting, metallic jewelry highlights, detailed shadows. Silk brocade, gold embroidery, pearls, kingfisher feather, lacquer, and bronze. Chinese luxury editorial aesthetic with MJ-inspired high detail, cinematic 16:9.
